_comment: Central registry for multi-year support. Single source of truth shared by the sync tool (scrape_hacktown.py) and the web app (index.html). Each year declares a 'provider' (which sync module fetches it) and an 'api' block with that provider's connection details. Add a year under 'years', set 'enabled': true when ready, and set 'activeYear' to the year the app shows by default.

2026._note: 2026 lives in a public Supabase project read by the Lovable embed on hacktown.com.br/programacao/. The apikey is a public publishable key (safe to commit); if it starts returning 401 it was rotated — re-extract from town-schedule-hub.lovable.app assets. Run: python scrape_hacktown.py --year 2026
